description: DB-Agent 自研 NL-to-Database 固定评测集。离线规划使用人工标注的 oracle_intent，不评估模型意图分类；并列指标、维度、趋势、业务日历、OperationGraph、大 Schema、参考 SQL 和安全通道验证列明的确定性协议。独立真实模型通道包含 12 个固定 SQLite 查询，覆盖单表聚合、过滤、分组、反连接、多跳 JOIN、日期范围和零值保留；模型结果不并入离线总通过率。

reference_sql_cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM orders

reference_sql_cases.question: 已付款订单的成交额是多少？
reference_sql_cases.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS paid_revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid'

reference_sql_cases.question: 按区域统计已付款订单成交额。
reference_sql_cases.sql: SELECT c.region, ROUND(SUM(o.amount), 2) AS paid_revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY c.region

reference_sql_cases.question: 哪些客户还没有订单？
reference_sql_cases.sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id WHERE o.id IS NULL ORDER BY c.name

reference_sql_cases.question: 已付款订单成交额最高的客户是谁？
reference_sql_cases.sql: WITH paid_totals AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT c.name, ROUND(p.total, 2) AS paid_revenue FROM paid_totals p JOIN customers c ON c.id = p.customer_id ORDER BY p.total DESC, c.id LIMIT 1

reference_sql_cases.question: 按客户区域统计已付款订单明细金额
reference_sql_cases.sql: SELECT c.region, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY c.region
